# Quantum Pi Forge (QPF)
Domain: quantumpiforge.com
Topic: Level-0 artifact verification, deterministic JCS-RFC8785 canonicalization, sha256 manifest reconciliation.

## EXT-001: Frozen Verification Triple
- Description: Standalone Python (stdlib only, 3.8+) reproducer for qpfv0 and qpfpkg0 without cloning QPF monorepo.
- Status: FROZEN. Content change invalidates identities below.
- Scope: Content identity only. Not a statement about OpenZeppelin security, correctness, or audit status.
- Docs: https://quantumpiforge.com/attack-kit/EXT-001/
- License: QPF files MIT (Pi Forge Collective - Quantum Genesis Initiative, Lead: Kris Olofson). artifact.bin: OpenZeppelin MIT, SPDX-MIT, v5.0.0.

### Reproduce
curl -fsSO https://quantumpiforge.com/attack-kit/EXT-001/verify.py
curl -fsSO https://quantumpiforge.com/attack-kit/EXT-001/manifest.json
curl -fsSO https://quantumpiforge.com/attack-kit/EXT-001/pin.json
curl -fsSO https://quantumpiforge.com/attack-kit/EXT-001/artifact.bin
curl -fsSO https://quantumpiforge.com/attack-kit/EXT-001/receipt.json
curl -fsSO https://quantumpiforge.com/attack-kit/EXT-001/expected-result.json
python3 verify.py

### Expected
- qpfv0: qpfv0:44a9b8cfbcd6eb3dfc83e93b1312f4511a4d42de77cd24afcea198bb424f9db8
- qpfpkg0: qpfpkg0:54f7af2c1ab97709f0813815036bcde62bfb3165107426a0f6a952d9c97cb1c2
- Note: qpfv0 is timestamp-stable. qpfpkg0 hashes the frozen expected-result.json bytes; re-running with fresh timestamp legitimately yields different qpfpkg0.

### Files
- verify.py: JCS-RFC8785 + sha256 derivation (result-id.js, package.js, canonical.js port)
- manifest.json: frozen file hashes + derivation rules
- pin.json: OpenZeppelin/openzeppelin-contracts @932fddf69a699a9a80fd2396fd1a2ab91cdda123 tag v5.0.0 path contracts/access/Ownable.sol
- artifact.bin / receipt.json / expected-result.json: frozen triple
